notes.title: City Noodle Shop Simulator Version 1.1 Update
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone, City Noodle Shop Simulator has been updated to version 1.1. The update details are as follows:[/p][list][*][p]Developed a new "Create New Noodle" feature; the research time is determined by the chef's average stats.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the loan limit; you can now take a loan of 1 million at the start of the game.[/p][/*][*][p]If the player has debt when the final ending is triggered, the ending cannot be achieved.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized some UI elements to improve the art quality.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the algorithm for deducting customer popularity; it now deducts popularity based on the customer's level.[/p][/*][*][p]When replacing chairs of different grades, the previous chairs will be automatically sold, and the money will be refunded.[/p][/*][*][p]The "Skip Preparation" function becomes available after defeating the first competitor.[/p][/*][*][p]Added sound effect prompts when using the "Skip Preparation" function.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a "Pixel Density" setting in the options; lowering it can make the game run smoother on lower-end devices.[/p][/*][*][p]The credits (STAFF roll) can now be skipped. After skipping, the game returns directly to the current progress instead of the title screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the price of "Learn New Noodle" due to the addition of the "Create New Noodle" system.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly increased the management difficulty in the "Business District" scenario.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the "Weekly Customer Count" and "Weekly Revenue" achievements could not be unlocked.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]We hope the new version provides a better gaming experience. As the developer is solely responsible for both development and testing, there might be some undiscovered issues. If you encounter any bugs, please report them via the community or the in-game feedback method, and I will fix them as soon as possible.[/p]

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 Update

Hello everyone, the game has been updated to version 1.0.3. Here are the changes in this version:

Fixed the issue of missing surfaces on connected tables and chairs
Fixed a text display error when competitors were about to arrive
Fixed the problem of the "low cost-performance" prompt appearing in easy mode

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 Update

After lowering surface quality, text color will become lighter

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, version 1.0.1 has been updated. Here are the update details:

Adjusted the size of some UI interfaces (mainly the renovation interface)

Fixed a text error in the prompt that appears during the first Chef School session

Added a content reminder for insufficient staff stamina when the "Customer Popularity" statistic is enabled in the store function

notes.title: "City Noodle Shop Simulator" Version 1.0 Official Release on June 6th!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Since the launch of the Early Access version of City Noodle Shop, we have received a lot of feedback from players. We have made every effort to address and optimize the issues based on your suggestions. Now, we believe the game's content and experience have reached a polished state, so we are thrilled to announce that City Noodle Shop Simulator will officially exit Early Access and launch Version 1.0 on June 6th!

Thank you all for your continuous support and feedback. It is your passion that has helped this lively simulation game grow and improve.

In Version 1.0, we have primarily optimized various interactive experiences, fixing over 100 issues in total. The detailed update notes will be announced separately upon release.

From now until June 6th, the Early Access version will remain available for purchase and play. The game will automatically update to the official version upon release. We sincerely appreciate all the feedback from our players, which has allowed us to bring the game to where it is today.

City Noodle Shop Simulator Producer — Feng2

notes.title: Version 0.6 Update Notes: Added Difficulty Options‌
notes.notes:
Version 0.6 has been updated. This update introduces a new difficulty selection feature, offering Easy, Normal, and Hard difficulty options, with Normal set as the default difficulty. You can modify the game difficulty at any time through the settings menu to make your gaming experience more enjoyable.

notes.title: Version 0.5 is scheduled to be updated on February 17th, with content preview
notes.notes:
Hello, players. After two months of development, the EA version 0.5 of the urban noodle restaurant plan will be updated on the morning of February 17th
Here is a brief description of the update content for everyone

[b]Note: Version 0.5 requires starting a new save file to play. Old save files can still be used to continue playing, but you will not be able to experience the new content. Furthermore, subsequent updates will not require restarting the save file[/b]

[h1]Important new features[/h1]

[h2]Competitor's Strategy[/h2]

After the game progresses to a certain stage, the "Competitor" feature will be activated. The competitor panel data will be displayed on the screen. Once competitors appear, they will influence the player's business through various means, such as reducing the popularity of the player's store. What the player needs to do is to ensure that their [b]weekly income[/b] exceeds that of their competitors. After maintaining this for a certain period of time, the competitors will retreat
The overall difficulty of the competitors is relatively low, and it is only with the last competitor that you will be exposed to some advanced gameplay strategies of the game

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067608/f564602a45e75c1a7ca1221709690a33fcd1fa7f.png[/img]

In the game, besides the novice competitor, there will be a total of 5 competitors coming to challenge. After completing all the challenges from the competitors, the player will reach the game's conclusion
According to the author's game time records, it took approximately 10 hours to reach the game's conclusion

[h2]Time Reversal Function[/h2]

Starting from the third month of gameplay, players can rewind their gameplay by one month at a time, with a maximum of 12 months. Time rewinding allows players to continue playing based on their previous records, enabling them to undo their mistakes at any time

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067608/e1921b9388873f408e68de7200943bdf69acf494.png[/img]


[h1]General new features[/h1]

Occasionally, news pop-ups can be seen in the game
When the player's funds are insufficient to pay the next month's salary, the game BGM (background music) will change
After completing the game, the "skip preparation" feature will be available, allowing players to bypass the setup content at the end of the business phase

[h1]Optimization and Adjustment[/h1]

The game values have undergone significant adjustments. Overall, the difficulty of early-stage operations has been reduced, while the difficulty of attracting mid-to-high-level customers has been increased
Customers' choices of noodle dishes have been carefully adjusted to reduce randomness, eliminating the issue of "the more types of noodles served, the harder it is to sell them all."
"Exit" during gameplay should be changed to "Title"
When setting the price and quantity in the menu, you can modify the digits by clicking the buttons, or you can also enter the digits yourself
Optimized some UI elements and added click sounds to buttons that should have them
If the recruitment of customers is unsuccessful, they will stand at the entrance of the store to inform
A "?" button has been added to some UIs. Clicking it will display relevant help
The "Learn New Skill" feature has undergone significant adjustments. After a period of game time, a random skill learning menu will automatically pop up, and the redraw function has been removed
When the customer is seated, the waiting text prompt above their head changes to an emoticon prompt
Optimize the display of store content, and hide any unchanged content
The newly added text prompt for customer appearance rate has been changed to a buff-like icon mode
Streamline some plot elements and revise some storyline content
Adjust the novice task/reward panel to the right side
The notification panel has been unified, with the display of notifications such as cost notifications and promotions being standardized to the same format
Optimize the UI hierarchy of the notification panel, ensuring that important notifications will always float on top, even when multiple UIs are stacked on top of each other
When recruiting employees, if the recruitment is abandoned, the player will return to the recruitment panel, reducing the need for the player to recruit again
The upper limit of popularity points has been changed to 2000
The originally planned takeout-related features have been cancelled, as it was found that they did not significantly enhance the gaming experience
Introduce operational strategy features such as "free kimchi" and "free meals"
When moving, there will be no more deduction of moving fees, but instead, a sufficient security deposit will be required


After this update, you will be able to experience a complete game from the beginning to the end credits. However, our EA version is not yet complete. After completing the game, there will be some hidden content. We will update these contents in the next quarter (the second quarter of 2025, before June 30th)

notes.title: Version 0.5 is already in debugging and will be launched soon
notes.notes:
After about 2 months of development, version 0.5 has been completed. There are a lot of updates in version 0.5, and debugging is currently underway. Moreover, the debugging time for this version will be relatively long
The reason for issuing this announcement is to inform everyone of the current status of our project and to let everyone know our current progress. In short, the team is not running away and is about to update. We just need to spend more time on development to ensure that the next version is more mature. Please stay tuned

notes.title: Version 0.5 is expected to be updated in the first quarter of 2025
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, thank you for your feedback on the game. We have also learned that there are some areas that need to be polished in the game. Currently, we have started the development of version 0.5, which will be updated before March 31, 2025 at the latest. Of course, we will try our best to update earlier than the expected time. At that time, we will issue an announcement in advance to notify everyone. This announcement is mainly to preview the main content of the new version and let everyone know that we are continuing to produce the new version

[h1] The new version mainly includes the following updates [/h1]
It will add some game music to solve the fatigue problem caused by the current version constantly cycling through one music
Add a new gameplay that mainly solves the problem of players lacking challenges after successfully managing their business
Optimize the early stages of the game to help players better perceive what reinforcement is needed to attract customers
Optimize details

The above is not the accurate content of the version update. The specific content will be announced to everyone about 1-2 weeks before the update

notes.title: Demo version offline Line on December 15th
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, the EA version of our game is expected to be launched on December 16th, and the demo will be taken offline on December 15th
The reason for going offline is that there are too many differences between the demo version and the EA version. After the game enters the official version, we may launch a new demo
